info.name: ITSM Device Management API
info.description:
Requests and tests for the ITSM API. Select the 'ITSM local' environment, set demo_password, then run the whole collection in order (Auth first). Status code tests cover each module and the role checks (403).

Author: Tamang Amish

item.name: Auth
item.description: Run this folder first. Each login stores its token in a collection variable. The IT admin login also saves the environment variable token, which most requests use.

exec: pm.test("has items and a total", () => { pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(body.total).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: Checklist of a device in kitting
RBAC: manager cannot see the board

exec: pm.test("every loan is past due and open", () => pm.response.json().items.forEach(l => { pm.expect(l.returned_at).to.eql(null); pm.expect(new Date(l.due_at) < new Date()).to.be.true; }));
pm.test("one department only", () => pm.expect(new Set(items.map(e => e.department)).size).to.eql(1));

exec: pm.test("all mine", () => { const ids = new Set(pm.response.json().items.map(t => t.requester.id)); pm.expect(ids.size).to.eql(1); });

item.description: Creates one ticket. The public demo resets its data every night.

exec: pm.test("newest first", () => { for (let i = 1; i < items.length; i++) pm.expect(new Date(items[i-1].created_at) >= new Date(items[i].created_at)).to.be.true; });
